title: "Understanding Cosine Similarity: Key Uses Explained"
description: Cosine similarity is a mathematical metric that measures the orientation-based similarity between two vectors, ranging from -1 to 1, without considering their magnitude. It is widely used in text analysis, recommendation systems, and clustering for analyzing relationships in datasets effectively.
